supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Significant extension beyond the outer ocular corners, particularly visible on the left lateral margin.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between a pale, low-melanin muzzle and a dark, high-melanin periocular and mid-face region.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate 2D vertical thickness with a distinct structural droop of the lower lip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread depigmented mottling and pale speckling across the lower muzzle and chin area.
other_distinctive_markers: Sparse, light-colored hair growth along the inferior margin of the chin.
